agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has no pushes; controller should balance but seeded sensor_noise=0.0053 injects persistent angle measurement error. Controller integrates this bias into a slow leftward drift (v ~ -1.36 m/s near end) while pole remains well within limits (margin ~0.72 rad). Over 374 steps cart drifts from x≈-0.09 to x=-2.405, exceeding |x|<=2.4 track. Removing noise (counterfactual) eliminates drift and violation, confirming sensor_noise as cause.
